top_signals.title: DOF Group Awarded Two AHTS Vessel Contracts
top_signals.summary: DOF Group ASA has been awarded firm contracts with a duration of more than 1 year and expected commencement in Q1 of 2027 for two of its AHTS vessels. The expected value of each contract is Significant, which DOF defines as contracts with value between USD$15 and 25 million.
